body.summary: Automate the confirmed standard Invoice 3-Way Match case while exceptions remain human-controlled.

body.commercialSummary: Expected operating cost savings are EUR 120,000 per year.

body.problem: Analysts manually compare invoices, purchase orders, and goods receipts.

body.currentState: Exceptions are identified late and routed through email.

body.included: Measure automatic handling rate and exception cycle time.

body.later: Add supplier-response measurement after the initial stage.

chapters.title: The solution and the to-be process

body.solution: Read invoice and ERP data, apply confirmed matching rules, and queue exceptions for human review.

body.targetState: Standard matches are prepared automatically; people decide exception cases.

body.requirement: Compare invoice, purchase order, and goods receipt.
Flag duplicate invoice numbers for review.
Route tolerance exceptions to a human approver.
Supplier communication remains for a later stage.
Invoices above EUR 10,000 require human approval.
